title: Bill Schmidt
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: Bill Schmidt painted these covers for HAN SOLO AND THE LOST LEGACY (front) by Brian Daley, and LANDO CALRISSIAN AND THE MINDHARP OF SHAW (back) by L. Neil Smith. Schmidt used a French food processor to model the troopers for LOST LEGACY. A skull substituted for the mask of Darth Vader when permission wasn't granted to use the Dark Lord's image. (Collection of William Plumb.)
